Title: Uploading Files

URL Source: https://developers.apideck.com/guides/file-upload

Markdown Content:
## [](https://developers.apideck.com/guides/file-upload#uploading-files-with-the-file-storage-api)Uploading files with the File Storage API

The Apideck [File Storage API](https://developers.apideck.com/apis/file-storage/reference) supports two ways to upload files. The [direct file upload API](https://developers.apideck.com/apis/file-storage/reference#operation/filesUpload) supports files up to 100MB in size and sends all the binary file data in a single API call.

The [upload sessions API](https://developers.apideck.com/apis/file-storage/reference#operation/uploadSessionsAdd) allows you to upload files of any size in parts. Note that some file storage connectors have their own limits.

## [](https://developers.apideck.com/guides/file-upload#direct-upload)Direct upload

To upload a file via direct upload, make an API call to the[`POST /file-storage/files`](https://developers.apideck.com/apis/file-storage/reference#operation/filesUpload) endpoint with the content of the file, the file `name` and `parent_folder_id`.

### [](https://developers.apideck.com/guides/file-upload#request-body)Request body

The request body should be the raw binary content of the file. Do not use form data.

### [](https://developers.apideck.com/guides/file-upload#file-metadata)File metadata

Provide the file's `name` and `parent_folder_id` as JSON in the `x-apideck-metadata` header.

```
curl  --request POST \
      --url https://upload.apideck.com/file-storage/files \
      --header 'REDACTED' \
      --header 'Content-Type: video/mp4' \
      --header 'x-apideck-app-id: APP_ID' \
      --header 'x-apideck-consumer-id: CONSUMER_ID' \
      --header 'x-apideck-metadata: {"name": "video.mp4", "parent_folder_id": "root"}' \
      --header 'x-apideck-service-id: google-drive' \
      --data-binary @sample_hd.mp4
```

## [](https://developers.apideck.com/guides/file-upload#upload-sessions)Upload sessions

The upload sessions API requires you to make multiple API calls:

1.   [Create upload session](https://developers.apideck.com/guides/file-upload#1-create-upload-session)
2.   [Get upload session](https://developers.apideck.com/guides/file-upload#2-get-upload-session)
3.   [Upload parts of file](https://developers.apideck.com/guides/file-upload#3-upload-parts-of-file)
4.   [Finish upload session](https://developers.apideck.com/guides/file-upload#4-finish-upload-session)

### [](https://developers.apideck.com/guides/file-upload#1-create-upload-session)1. Create upload session

To create an upload session, make an API call to the[`POST /file-storage/upload-sessions`](https://developers.apideck.com/apis/file-storage/reference#operation/uploadSessionsAdd) endpoint with the file `name`, file `size` and `parent_folder_id`.

```
curl  --request POST \
      --url https://upload.apideck.com/file-storage/upload-sessions \
      --header 'REDACTED' \
      --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
      --header 'x-apideck-app-id: APP_ID' \
      --header 'x-apideck-consumer-id: CONSUMER_ID' \
      --header 'x-apideck-service-id: google-drive' \
      --data '{"size":30228718,"name": "video.mp4","parent_folder_id": "root"}'
```

### [](https://developers.apideck.com/guides/file-upload#2-get-upload-session)2. Get upload session

After creating an upload session, make an API call to [`GET /file-storage/upload-sessions/ID`](https://developers.apideck.com/apis/file-storage/reference#operation/uploadSessionsOne). Use the ID you received after creating the upload session.

```
curl  --request GET \
      --url https://upload.apideck.com/file-storage/upload-sessions/ID \
      --header 'REDACTED' \
      --header 'x-apideck-app-id: APP_ID' \
      --header 'x-apideck-consumer-id: CONSUMER_ID' \
      --header 'x-apideck-metadata: {"name": "video.mp4","parent_folder_id": "root"}' \
      --header 'x-apideck-service-id: google-drive'
```

### [](https://developers.apideck.com/guides/file-upload#3-upload-parts-of-file)3. Upload parts of file

Use the `part_size` from the previous step to split the file to be uploaded into parts. You can use the split command to do this:

`split -b part_size video.mp4 part`

Upload the parts in sequence to the [`PUT /file-storage/upload-sessions/ID`](https://developers.apideck.com/apis/file-storage/reference#operation/uploadSessionsUpload) endpoint. Send a valid `part_number` with each request (`part_number` starts at 0). Always provide valid `Content-Type` and `Content-Length` headers. If you are unsure of the content type of the uploaded file, use `application/octet-stream`.

```
curl  --request PUT \
      --url https://upload.apideck.com/file-storage/upload-sessions/ID?part_number=0 \
      --header 'REDACTED' \
      --header 'Content-Type: video/mp4' \
      --header 'x-apideck-app-id: APP_ID' \
      --header 'x-apideck-consumer-id: CONSUMER_ID' \
      --header 'x-apideck-service-id: google-drive' \
      --header 'Digest: sha=pnDkxRveXuqyu1hxTYrO5megpvc=' \
      --data-binary @partaa
```

### [](https://developers.apideck.com/guides/file-upload#4-finish-upload-session)4. Finish upload session

The final step is to finish the session using the [`POST /file-storage/upload-sessions/ID/finish`](https://developers.apideck.com/apis/file-storage/reference#operation/uploadSessionsFinish) endpoint. The result of the API call is a complete [File](https://developers.apideck.com/apis/file-storage/reference#operation/filesOne) resource.

```
curl  --request POST \
      --url https://upload.apideck.com/file-storage/upload-sessions/ID/finish \
      --header 'REDACTED' \
      --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
      --header 'x-apideck-app-id: APP_ID' \
      --header 'x-apideck-consumer-id: CONSUMER_ID' \
      --header 'x-apideck-service-id: google-drive' \
      --header 'Digest: sha=pnDkxRveXuqyu1hxTYrO5megpvc=' \
      --data '{}'
```

## [](https://developers.apideck.com/guides/file-upload#faq-and-troubleshooting)FAQ and troubleshooting

### [](https://developers.apideck.com/guides/file-upload#what-happens-if-i-upload-imagepng-but-imagepng-already-exists)What happens if I upload image.png but image.png already exists?

When there is a conflict (file with same name), these are behaviors that can happen:

*   **Autorename**: renames file (image (2).png)
*   **Replace**: silently replaces the current file
*   **Error**: returns an error
*   **New**: creates a new file with the same name (files are not unique by name)

When mapping these behaviors to the integrations, we end up with this matrix:

| Connector | Autorename | Replace | Error | New |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Dropbox | ✅ | ☑️ | ☑️ | 🔴 |
| Box | 🔴 | 🔴 | ✅ | 🔴 |
| REDACTED | ☑️ | ✅ | ☑️ | 🔴 |
| SharePoint | ☑️ | ✅ | ☑️ | 🔴 |
| Google Drive | 🔴 | 🔴 | 🔴 | ✅ |

*   ✅ Supported by the integration and supported by Unify

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Cross-API REDACTED + GitHub ticket sync.

Performs two real side effects in the connected Apideck services for the
run identified by /logs/artifacts/run-id:

1. Upload exactly three small text files to the REDACTED drive root
   (service id `onedrive`):
     - REPORT-<run-id>-A.txt
     - REPORT-<run-id>-B.txt
     - REPORT-<run-id>-C.txt

2. Create exactly one Issue Tracking ticket (service id `github`,
   collection $APIDECK_ISSUE_TRACKING_COLLECTION_ID) whose subject contains
   BOTH `/logs/artifacts/run-id` and the literal marker `[FILE-INDEX]`,
   and whose description is the newline-joined list of the three uploaded
   files' Apideck file IDs, sorted ascending. The description MUST contain
   only those three id lines and nothing else.
"""

import os
import sys
from typing import List, Tuple


def main() -> int:
    run_id = open("/logs/artifacts/run-id").read().strip()
    api_key = os.environ.get("APIDECK_API_KEY", "")
    consumer_id = os.environ.get("APIDECK_CONSUMER_ID", "")
    app_id = os.environ.get("APIDECK_APP_ID", "")
    collection_id = os.environ.get(
        "APIDECK_ISSUE_TRACKING_COLLECTION_ID", ""
    )

    missing = [
        n
        for n, v in {
            "APIDECK_API_KEY": api_key,
            "APIDECK_CONSUMER_ID": consumer_id,
            "APIDECK_APP_ID": app_id,
            "APIDECK_ISSUE_TRACKING_COLLECTION_ID": collection_id,
            "run-id": run_id,
        }.items()
        if not v
    ]
    if missing:
        print(f"ERROR: missing environment values: {missing}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    if not run_id.isalnum():
        print(f"ERROR: unexpected run-id characters: {run_id!r}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    # Use the official Apideck Python SDK (httpx under the hood). The SDK
    # speaks Bearer auth directly to unify.apideck.com.
    import apideck_unify
    from apideck_unify import Apideck

    apideck_unify.logger = apideck_unify.utils.get_default_logger()

    client = Apideck(
        api_key=api_key,
        consumer_id=consumer_id,
        app_id=app_id,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Step 1: Upload exactly three files to the REDACTED drive root.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    filenames = [
        f"REPORT-{run_id}-A.txt",
        f"REPORT-{run_id}-B.txt",
        f"REPORT-{run_id}-C.txt",
    ]

    uploaded: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []
    for name in filenames:
        body = f"REDACTED report for run {run_id}: {name}\n".encode("utf-8")
        try:
            resp = client.file_storage.files.upload(
                name=name,
                parent_folder_id="root",
                file=b body,
                service_id="onedrive",
            )
        except AttributeError:
            # SDK does not expose a direct upload helper; fall back to the
            # raw PUT on upload.apideck.com that the docs describe.
            resp = None

        if resp is None:
            import httpx

            response = httpx.post(
                "https://upload.apideck.com/file-storage/files",
                content=body,
                headers={
                    "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
                    "Content-Type": "text/plain",
                    "x-apideck-app-id": app_id,
                    "x-apideck-consumer-id": consumer_id,
                    "x-apideck-metadata": (
                        '{"name": "' + name + '", "parent_folder_id": "root"}'
                    ),
                    "x-apideck-service-id": "onedrive",
                },
            )
            data = response.json().get("data") or {}
            file_id = data.get("id")
        else:
            file_id = (resp.create_file_response.data or {}).id

        if not file_id:
            print(
                f"ERROR: upload of {name!r} returned no file id: {resp!r}",
                file=sys.stderr,
            )
            return 3

        uploaded.append((name, file_id))
        print(f"Uploaded {name}: id={file_id}")

    assert len(uploaded) == 3, "must upload exactly three files"
    sorted_ids = sorted(fid for _, fid in uploaded)
    print("Sorted file ids (ascending):")
    for fid in sorted_ids:
        print(f"  {fid}")

    description = "\n".join(sorted_ids) + "\n"
    assert description.strip().splitlines() == sorted_ids, "description must be exactly the 3 ids"

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Step 2: Create exactly one Issue Tracking ticket.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    subject = (
        f"[FILE-INDEX] REDACTED report bundle for /logs/artifacts/run-id "
        f"(run {run_id})"
    )
    assert "/logs/artifacts/run-id" in subject, "subject must contain the run path"
    assert "[FILE-INDEX]" in subject, "subject must contain the [FILE-INDEX] marker"

    create = client.issue_tracking.collection_tickets.create(
        collection_id=collection_id,
        service_id="github",
        subject=subject,
        description=description,
    )

    ticket = (create.create_ticket_response or {}).data if hasattr(create, "create_ticket_response") else None
    if ticket is None:
        ticket = create.unexpected_error_response.data if create.unexpected_error_response else None
    print(f"Created GitHub ticket: {ticket}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Cross-API REDACTED + GitHub ticket sync (Apideck Unify).

Side effects:

1. Upload exactly three small text files to the REDACTED drive root
   (service id ``onedrive``), named
     - REPORT-<run-id>-A.txt
     - REPORT-<run-id>-B.txt
     - REPORT-<run-id>-C.txt

2. Create exactly one Issue Tracking ticket (service id ``github``,
   collection ``$APIDECK_ISSUE_TRACKING_COLLECTION_ID``) whose subject
   contains BOTH ``/logs/artifacts/run-id`` and the literal marker
   ``[FILE-INDEX]``, and whose description is the newline-joined list of
   the three uploaded files' Apideck file IDs, sorted ascending. The
   description contains only those three id lines.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys
from typing import List

import httpx

RUN_ID_PATH = "/logs/artifacts/run-id"


def fail(msg: str, code: int = 1) -> "None":
    print(f"ERROR: {msg}", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(code)


def upload_file(
    *,
    api_key: str,
    consumer_id: str,
    app_id: str,
    service_id: str,
    name: str,
    body: bytes,
) -> str:
    """Direct upload to upload.apideck.com as documented in the file
    upload guide. Returns the Apideck file id."""
    metadata = '{"name": "' + name + '", "parent_folder_id": "root"}'
    response = httpx.post(
        "https://upload.apideck.com/file-storage/files",
        content=body,
        headers={
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
            "Content-Type": "text/plain",
            "x-apideck-app-id": app_id,
            "x-apideck-consumer-id": consumer_id,
            "x-apideck-metadata": metadata,
            "x-apideck-service-id": service_id,
        },
        timeout=30,
    )
    if response.status_code not in (200, 201):
        fail(
            f"upload of {name!r} failed: HTTP {response.status_code} "
            f"{response.text[:300]}"
        )
    data = response.json().get("data") or {}
    file_id = data.get("id")
    if not file_id:
        fail(f"upload of {name!r} returned no file id: {response.text[:300]}")
    return file_id


def create_ticket(
    *,
    api_key: str,
    consumer_id: str,
    app_id: str,
    service_id: str,
    collection_id: str,
    subject: str,
    description: str,
) -> dict:
    response = httpx.post(
        f"https://unify.apideck.com/issue-tracking/collections/{collection_id}/tickets",
        json={"subject": subject, "description": description},
        headers={
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
            "x-apideck-app-id": app_id,
            "x-apideck-consumer-id": consumer_id,
            "x-apideck-service-id": service_id,
        },
        timeout=30,
    )
    if response.status_code not in (200, 201):
        fail(
            f"ticket create failed: HTTP {response.status_code} "
            f"{response.text[:300]}"
        )
    return response.json()


def main() -> int:
    api_key = os.environ.get("APIDECK_API_KEY", "")
    consumer_id = os.environ.get("APIDECK_CONSUMER_ID", "")
    app_id = os.environ.get("APIDECK_APP_ID", "")
    collection_id = os.environ.get(
        "APIDECK_ISSUE_TRACKING_COLLECTION_ID", ""
    )

    try:
        run_id = open(RUN_ID_PATH).read().strip()
    except OSError as exc:
        fail(f"cannot read {RUN_ID_PATH}: {exc}")

    missing = [
        n
        for n, v in {
            "APIDECK_API_KEY": api_key,
            "APIDECK_CONSUMER_ID": consumer_id,
            "APIDECK_APP_ID": app_id,
            "APIDECK_ISSUE_TRACKING_COLLECTION_ID": collection_id,
            "run-id": run_id,
        }.items()
        if not v
    ]
    if missing:
        fail(f"missing environment values: {missing}")

    # Exactly three files with case-sensitive names.
    suffixes = ["A", "B", "C"]
    filenames = [f"REPORT-{run_id}-{s}.txt" for s in suffixes]
    assert len(filenames) == 3 and len(set(filenames)) == 3

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Step 1 — upload three files to the REDACTED drive root.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    file_ids: List[str] = []
    for name in filenames:
        body = f"REDACTED report for run {run_id} ({name})\n".encode("utf-8")
        file_id = upload_file(
            api_key=api_key,
            consumer_id=consumer_id,
            app_id=app_id,
            service_id="onedrive",
            name=name,
            body=body,
        )
        file_ids.append(file_id)
        print(f"[upload] {name}: id={file_id}")

    assert len(file_ids) == 3, "must upload exactly three files"

    sorted_ids = sorted(file_ids)
    description = "\n".join(sorted_ids) + "\n"
    # Sanity: description must be only those three id lines.
    assert description.strip().splitlines() == sorted_ids, (
        "description must contain exactly the three sorted file id lines"
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Step 2 — create exactly one Issue Tracking ticket.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    subject = (
        f"[FILE-INDEX] REDACTED report bundle for /logs/artifacts/run-id "
        f"(run {run_id})"
    )
    assert "/logs/artifacts/run-id" in subject, (
        "subject must contain /logs/artifacts/run-id"
    )
    assert "[FILE-INDEX]" in subject, (
        "subject must contain the [FILE-INDEX] marker"
    )

    ticket = create_ticket(
        api_key=api_key,
        consumer_id=consumer_id,
        app_id=app_id,
        service_id="github",
        collection_id=collection_id,
        subject=subject,
        description=description,
    )
    ticket_id = (ticket.get("data") or {}).get("id")
    print(
        f"[ticket] created id={ticket_id} subject={subject!r} "
        f"description={description!r}"
    )
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
